stopPoints.label: Richard Rabbit arrives
stopPoints.question:
Question (Friends): 'Who comes to play at Peppa's house?'
Options: 'A) Richard Rabbit 🐰
B) Danny Dog 🐶'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Richard Rabbit!'

stopPoints.label: George's best friend
stopPoints.question:
Question (Friends): 'Who is George's best friend?'
Options: 'A) Richard Rabbit 🐰
B) Suzy Sheep 🐑'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Richard Rabbit!'

stopPoints.label: Knocking down the house
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What did Richard do to Peppa's toy house?'
Options: 'A) He knocked it down! 💥
B) He painted it! 🎨'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'He knocked it down!'

stopPoints.label: Bedroom turns into Dinosaur Land
stopPoints.question:
Question (Playtime): 'What did the boys turn the bedroom into?'
Options: 'A) Dinosaur Land! 🦕
B) A swimming pool! 🏊'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Dinosaur Land!'

stopPoints.label: Rainy day activities
stopPoints.question:
Question (Activities): 'What is a good thing to do on a rainy day?'
Options: 'A) Watch important TV programmes! 📺
B) Go to the beach! 🏖️'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Watch TV!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa feels lonely
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feelings): 'Why is Peppa feeling sad?'
Options: 'A) She has no one to play with 😢
B) She lost her toy 🧸'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'She has no one to play with!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa's best friend
stopPoints.question:
Question (Friends): 'Who is Peppa's best friend?'
Options: 'A) Suzy Sheep 🐑
B) Candy Cat 🐱'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Suzy Sheep!'

stopPoints.label: Suzy's costume
stopPoints.question:
Question (Clothes): 'What costume does Suzy want to wear?'
Options: 'A) A nurse's costume 👩‍⚕️
B) A fairy's costume 🧚‍♀️'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'A nurse's costume!'

stopPoints.label: Suzy declares it a hospital
stopPoints.question:
Question (Pretend Play): 'What does Nurse Suzy say the bedroom is now?'
Options: 'A) A hospital 🏥
B) Dinosaur Land 🦕'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'A hospital!'

stopPoints.label: Sick dinosaur color
stopPoints.question:
Question (Colors): 'What color is the sick dinosaur?'
Options: 'A) A greeny ill color 🤢
B) A happy red color ❤️'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Green!'

stopPoints.label: A railway station
stopPoints.question:
Question (Pretend Play): 'What did the boys turn the hospital into?'
Options: 'A) A railway station 🚂
B) A school 🏫'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'A railway station!'

stopPoints.label: Trains in Fairyland
stopPoints.question:
Question (Fairyland): 'Are there any trains in Fairyland?'
Options: 'A) No, no trains! ❌
B) Yes, lots of trains! ✅'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'No trains!'

stopPoints.label: Girls' games
stopPoints.question:
Question (Playtime): 'What do Peppa and Suzy want to play?'
Options: 'A) Hospitals and fairies 🧚‍♀️
B) Dinosaurs and trains 🦕'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Hospitals and fairies!'

stopPoints.label: Playing outside
stopPoints.question:
Question (Locations): 'Where does Mummy Pig say they can all play?'
Options: 'A) Outside! 🌳
B) In the kitchen! 🍳'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Outside!'

stopPoints.label: Muddy puddles
stopPoints.question:
Question (Outdoors): 'What do you find in the garden after it rains?'
Options: 'A) Muddy puddles! 🤎
B) Snowmen! ⛄'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Muddy puddles!'

stopPoints.label: Jumping in puddles
stopPoints.question:
Question (Activities): 'Who loves jumping up and down in muddy puddles?'
Options: 'A) Everyone! 🙌
B) Only big girls! 👧'
Guidance: Encourage Mia and Zero to say: 'Everyone!'
